purpose: Freeze the paired D0 data stream and training semantics shared by every official-backbone base versus MERIT-full comparison.
full_training_blocker: The separate G11 implementation manifest remains BLOCKED until official source snapshots, isolated dependencies, parameter/FLOP audit, and official forward/backward smoke are complete.

source_bank.reuse_policy: Reuse the immutable C006 D0 bank without rebuilding or selecting new crops.
source_bank.parent_split_rule: Every crop from a physical parent inherits one split; parent SHA-256 sets must be disjoint between train and synthetic_holdout.
forbidden_sources: model outputs used for crop selection

same_within_pair: optimizer, scheduler, batch size, step count, and sample order

allowed_arm_differences.base: Prompt channels are both zero and the loss is fidelity only.
allowed_arm_differences.merit_full: Prompt channels carry the frozen oracle blur/noise scalars and the loss adds the frozen DeepCrack probability L1 term with weight 5.0. This is a package/bundle comparison, not a single-component causal ablation.

paired_comparison.initialization_rule: Set all deterministic seeds, instantiate the official backbone and common adapter, hash the initial state, then load the frozen DeepCrack model only for merit_full. Matching arms must have the same initial-state hash.
paired_comparison.stream_pairing_rule: Generate the latent sample once per seed and step. Channel 0, target, bank index, degradation parameters, and noise draw must be byte-identical across arms; only input channels 1-2 may differ.

draw_order_per_batch: bank indices for the whole batch via randint
for each selected sample: sigma_h uniform, sigma_v uniform, noise_std uniform, standard-normal noise array

training.task_loss: L1 between frozen DeepCrack probabilities of restored and clean target

hard_stops: Any bank, manifest, ledger, protocol, or DeepCrack hash mismatch.
Any physical-parent SHA-256 present in both train and synthetic_holdout.
Any paired-arm mismatch in channel 0, target, metadata, degradation draw, sample order, or initial state.
Any base/full trainable-parameter mismatch within a backbone.
Any unapproved source dataset or model-output-based crop selection.
Any full run before both G11 and G13 are CLOSED.
